newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT offers ATM networks via satellite.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT offers ATM networks via satellite.

text.p: COMSAT Corp said Monday that it is now offering the first high-speed multimedia network service delivered via satellite and based on Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) standards.
COMSAT said that with its new service, companies can connect to advanced ATM networks virtually anywhere in the world at speeds as fast as 45 megabits per second.

During the past year, COMSAT has been testing its service with its telecommunications customers. Sprint Advanced Technology Laboratories, the research arm of Sprint Corp, has been testing the new service at its laboratories.

ATM is an advanced, broadband technology that enables high-speed, high-bandwidth applications -- including voice, data, image, video, multimedia and Internet to be transmitted over a single network simultaneously.
"This is a monumental breakthrough in the technology of international communications," said Susan Miller, director of advanced business applications for COMSAT World Systems.
"The availability of ATM via satellite opens doors for many companies, especially those who need to communicate with far-off places.
The service is now commercially available, COMSAT said.
